dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: We love you, too!

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: No way! Ah, thank you, thank you, thank you! I love you!

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Yes!  It is! Who knows we might have red velvet cake in the fridge!

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: Is it?

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text:
Yes Vic, we love you!
Now, food is almost ready. Go wash your hands and then help me set up the table. Your father is cooking your favourite dish!

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: Just don't hold anything inside and keep it to yourself. Come and talk to us. We love you Vic!

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text:
But like people say once something is on internet, it's forever there.  

Don't worry it always comes out eventually. Sooner or later.
Inshallah this will be over soon.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: Some bullies, when they got caught in real life, they might continue on internet.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: Or online. If she sends you anything inappropriate or do not let you take space in the class with small comments, we need to know.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Unfortunately, It might take a while for things to change so it's important for us to know if anything happens in school.

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: Ok. I promise I will talk to you.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: And remember you are important and loved. Sometimes it is easy to forget that when you are upset. So please don't feel alone.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: So far I heard that she apologized to you. That's good. Inshallah she would change her behaviour. If she continues to bother you, please promise us that you will tell us immediately, ok?

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text:
But unless somebody stops this behaviour those friends will be next.
Unfortunately when they grow up they continue to hurt other people around them to the point that they feel all alone all the time. Sometimes they even end up alone, and not by choice.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: And their friends might be even afraid to be the next one, so they protect Billie out of fear. Some of those friends might not even realize that they are afraid.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: They use their popularity and friends to attack others. This is how they cover whatever is wrong with them.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Oh honey, unfortunately there are a lot of Billies  in our lives.

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: Yes, how did you know? Did you already talked to the teachers?

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: And would she always act like "Relax, I'm just joking" each time she got caught.

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: How did you know? Whatever he did, she would find annoying, always she would say something mean!

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Let me guess, he was annoying to Billie and to the others?

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: Billie is super popular. She is always nice to the popular kids and to the teachers. Tim was... he was a bit silent. Nobody would listen to him.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: How about your teachers or Tim's parents? Nobody tried to stop her?

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: See! I told you if you would leave class it will be another classmate. Poor kid.

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: She was mocking Tim before. He changed schools.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: If not you then it will be someone else. Probably before you it was someone else.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: This is very important for you to understand. It's not because you did something wrong. Bullies always have an excuse to attack someone. Does not matter whatever you do.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Come sit. Listen Vic. This is not your fault. This is not about you. If someone is mocking and harassing you that means something is wrong about them not you.

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: Your mom is right, you have nothing to apologize for. We are always there for you.

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: For what? Nonsense. Now we have to hug you tighter and I don't want any objections!

dialogNode.speaker: Vic
dialogNode.text: I'm sorry, Mom!

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Oh Vic, we should have noticed earlier!

dialogNode.speaker: Dad
dialogNode.text: Yes, your mom told me about the phone call. Now come here and give us a big hug!

dialogNode.speaker: Mom
dialogNode.text: Welcome home Vic! Your father and I wanted to talk to you about your day!
